name: Algebraic Condition Obfuscation
description: Replaces the explicit inequality constraint S[u] != S[v] with a mathematical equivalent: requiring the quadratic equation z^2 - (C[u]+C[v])z + C[u]C[v] = 0 to have distinct real roots. This forces the model to symbolically resolve the equation to deduce the inequality, disrupting simple pattern matching on "different values at these indices".
